title.en: concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order — It prints 100–125 mm — read beside “Air flow - scfm”
title.zh: 只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单——它印 100–125 mm。——对照「空气 流量 - scfm」来读

description.en: concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order at /products/integrated-mixer-pump. It prints 100–125 mm Electric 20 prints 80 mm instead
description.zh: 只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单见 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。它印 100–125 mm。电动20印的是 80 mm。

h1.en: Air flow - nl/s is the heading; concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「空气 流量 - nl/s」，主体仍是只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order. The row to open is /products/integrated-mixer-pump. It prints 100–125 mm. Electric 20 prints 80 mm instead. 100 / 125 and 100–125 appear as the pages write them. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm with a hyphen, on a 450 kg page. The lists used here print 100 / 125 mm on the integrated mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60. Electric 30, Electric 40, Electric 80, Diesel 30 and Diesel 60 do not print a delivery-pipe diameter. If you already have 100 mm or 125 mm pipe, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not treat every pump as a match. The section title “Air flow - scfm” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单的数字。要打开的行是 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。它印 100–125 mm。电动20印的是 80 mm。100 / 125 和 100–125 按各页的写法出现。电动30、电动40、电动80、柴油30和柴油60不印输送管径。电动15用连字符印 100–125 mm，那是 450 kg 的页面。如果你已经有 100 mm 或 125 mm 的管子，河北品锦机械（邢台）不会把每台泵都当成匹配。此处使用的列表在搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 上印 100 / 125 mm。节标题「空气 流量 - scfm」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: “Air flow - scfm” titles this part of the concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order note. The figures stay the printed ones. It prints 100–125 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm with a hyphen, on a 450 kg page. If you already have 100 mm or 125 mm pipe, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not treat every pump as a match.
body.zh: 「空气 流量 - scfm」是只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。100 / 125 和 100–125 按各页的写法出现。电动15用连字符印 100–125 mm，那是 450 kg 的页面。如果你已经有 100 mm 或 125 mm 的管子，河北品锦机械（邢台）不会把每台泵都当成匹配。

body.en: For concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order, the heading “Air flow - nl/s” does not replace a cell. Electric 20 prints 80 mm instead. The lists used here print 100 / 125 mm on the integrated mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60.
body.zh: 对只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单而言，标题「空气 流量 - nl/s」并不替换任何格子。电动20印的是 80 mm。此处使用的列表在搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 上印 100 / 125 mm。

question.en: Does “Air flow - scfm” replace It prints 100–125 mm?
question.zh: 「空气 流量 - scfm」会替换「它印 100–125 mm。」吗？

answer.en: No. It prints 100–125 mm remains the printed wording for concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order.
answer.zh: 不会。它印 100–125 mm。仍是只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 20 prints 80 mm instead belong on the concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order row?
question.zh: 只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单这一行里，「电动20印的是 80 mm。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/integrated-mixer-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/integrated-mixer-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Air flow - nl/s” add to concrete pump 100 125 mm pipe order?
question.zh: 「空气 流量 - nl/s」给只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/vacuum-pumps-exhaust-piping-d_1198.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/vacuum-pumps-exhaust-piping-d_1198.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
